batch.summary: Message Batches API for large, unattended read-only jobs on the API credit

frustrated-mode.summary: Detects a stuck session, offers a read-only analysis and a plan, hands off only after approval

token-log.summary: Counts locally, at zero model cost, how many characters each hook hands the model and the API usage per turn; the plugin audit reads and prunes the log

bash-output-filter.summary: Rewrites plain test/build/lint commands so only the summary and the failure lines reach the context; the full output goes to a file (bypassPermissions only)

project-threads.summary: Claude Projects threads on this computer: status head on the thread title, the completion card and questions as thread replies, a worktree per thread and repo, no side sessions, session-start notices kept out of a thread, one setup hint per new project

claude-mods.summary: Claude Code mods: agent pane, budget and context band, ship/CI pane, branch-hygiene status, notice toasts, return recap, deterministic paste / tool-output redirect, and the fork-cache and wake spike commands
